abilities.text: If one or more artifact tokens would be created under your control, that many 5/5 red Dragon creature tokens with flying are created instead.

If one or more artifact tokens would be created under your control, that many 5/5 red Dragon creature tokens with flying are created instead.
oracleOverride.source: mtg.wtf https://mtg.wtf/card/pfra/80p/Draconic-Visitor (Reality Fracture Promos pfra 80p; not in data/cards.db or XMage; not verified against Scryfall)

notes: Ruling 2026-08-21 (1): effects that change who controls a token being created apply before this replacement; effects that change control as it enters apply after.

Ruling (2): a nonartifact token that becomes an artifact only as it enters (Mycosynth Lattice) is NOT replaced; artifact-ness is judged from the token's own characteristics at creation, before static effects. Tokens that are artifacts by definition (Treasure, Clue, Food, Thopter) ARE replaced.

Ruling (3): replaced tokens become 5/5 red Dragon creature tokens with flying and lose any abilities they would have been created with; other instructions of the creating effect still apply (enters tapped, enters attacking, haste, exile at end of combat).
